description: This source file defines the WorkoutDetailFragment class, which is a Fragment responsible for displaying workout details, including a video player, title, description, and a blurred background image. It manages media playback with ExoPlayer and loads images with Glide, applying transformations.

classes.name: WorkoutDetailFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays workout details including video playback and background imagery, manages media lifecycle, and binds UI elements.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, retrieves workout ID from arguments, and triggers workout data loading.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and sets up view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Observes ViewModel data to update UI elements and load images and video.

methods.name: initPlayer
methods.description: Initializes ExoPlayer with a media URL, prepares it, and starts playback.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Handles fragment stopping, releases media, and potentially saves progress.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up binding when view is destroyed.
